newsitem.title: USA: Butler National unit gets $1.7 mln order.
newsitem.headline: Butler National unit gets $1.7 mln order.

text.p: Butler National Corp said Wednesday it received an order at its Avcon Industries Inc subsidiary in Newton, Kan. valued at more than $1.7 million for aircraft modifications.

The order involves the company's Avcon Fins and proprietary work related to meteorological and military applications. The aircraft are scheduled to have modifications completed within the next seven months.
Butler is involved in the aerospace and services business sectors.
